items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: sometimes we’d do things with Milt Jackson... But sometimes Milt would be on some of the concerts.

ctx.x: Now did Creed have some say… did he influence who the people would be on a session or was that the leaders choice?

I don’t know, maybe both. A little bit of both, because I think Creed did Wes Montgomery as well I think, but that was on another label. I don’t know if it was Verve or not. Creed was a trumpet player, so he really liked Freddie. It was a nice atmosphere, got paid decent and tours were great. Travel was all the rage. It was great, had a good time, working with all these characters. Playing with Stanley and sometimes we’d do things with Milt Jackson because Milt did some things.
That’s right the Sunflower album, but that’s Billy Cobham on that one.
